cohort: 74,144 women who had a vaginal delivery between 24th and 44th weeks of gestation, excluding those who underwent cesarean section
finding: The presence of meconium-stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) was significantly associated with a higher risk of moderate and severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) after vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that meconium-stained amniotic fluid was significantly associated with a higher risk of moderate and severe postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal delivery.
